# betterado_pipeline (Resource)

Manages a Pipelines v2 pipeline (`_apis/pipelines`) in Azure DevOps. For classic build pipelines managed via the Build API, use `betterado_build_definition`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

resource "betterado_pipeline" "example" {
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
  name       = "My YAML Pipeline"
  folder     = "\\MyFolder"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the pipeline.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project in which the pipeline lives. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `configuration_type` (String) The configuration type. One of: `yaml`, `designerJson`, `justInTime`, `designerHyphenJson`, `unknown`. Defaults to `yaml`.
- `folder` (String) The folder path of the pipeline. Defaults to `\` (root folder).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The pipeline integer ID as a string (set as the resource ID).
- `revision` (Number) The pipeline revision number (optimistic concurrency token).
- `url` (String) The URL of the pipeline.
